final: WITH g AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS gsum, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), o AS (SELECT SUM(gsum) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.gsum, g.cnt, (g.gsum * 1.0) / o.total AS quotient FROM g JOIN o ON o.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quotient IS NULL, quotient DESC LIMIT 10
